institution.provenance: DRAFT decision-support protocol authored from standard-of-care knowledge (NCCN/DeVita/Harrison, general reference); experimental, not clinically activated

name: Epcoritamab (CD20xCD3 bispecific, subcutaneous)

premedications.name: CRS premedication
premedications.notes: steroid + antihistamine + antipyretic around the priming and first full doses

supportiveCare: Subcutaneous step-up dosing (priming and intermediate doses) in cycle 1 to reduce cytokine-release syndrome
Tumor-lysis prophylaxis; monitoring per CRS risk after early full doses
Continuous therapy until progression or unacceptable toxicity

drugs.name: Epcoritamab
drugs.notes: Subcutaneous; cycle 1 step-up (0.16 mg priming, 0.8 mg intermediate) then 48 mg full dose. Weekly in cycles 1-3, every 2 weeks cycles 4-9, then every 4 weeks (full 48 mg dose shown).
